name: SNES Buddies
tagline: Twenty 16-bit heroes who pace, squirm and float across your desktop.
credit: Sprites from Super Mario World, Kirby Super Star, Super Metroid, Donkey Kong Country 1-2, Mega Man X, Super Castlevania IV, Castlevania: Dracula X, Final Fight 3, Pac-Man 2, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles IV and Earthworm Jim — Nintendo, HAL, Rare, Capcom, Konami, Namco, Interplay and Shiny.
